ONOMATOPOEIA (sound) — slurping noodles or soup in one go; not rude in Korea
ONOMATOPOEIA (sound) — gulping down in one swallow; also swallowing hard from nerves
ONOMATOPOEIA (sound) — yum-yum, munching happily; childlike and cute

MIMETIC (manner) — flying freely on wide wings; also flames blazing up, or letting something go free

MIMETIC (manner) — air turning hot and stuffy; a face flushing with heat. adj 후끈하다
MIMETIC (manner) — toddling; a baby's first unsteady steps. 아장아장 걷다
MIMETIC (manner) — striding with long confident steps; also 성큼 다가오다 for a season arriving fast

MIMETIC (manner) — sneaking quietly so no one notices
MIMETIC (manner) — dashing off or finishing something in a quick burst
MIMETIC (manner) — staggering, unsteady on one's feet. verb 비틀거리다
MIMETIC (manner) — trudging wearily, heavy dragging steps after a hard day
MIMETIC (manner) — hopping; the rabbit word from the children's song

MIMETIC (manner) — dizzy, the room spinning. adj 어질어질하다
MIMETIC (manner) — queasy, stomach churning with nausea or nerves. verb 울렁거리다
